name: Suzhou Centec Communications Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Centec Communications Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, and sale of Ethernet switching chips and related products in China and internationally.It offers ethernet switch and ethernet transceiver PHY silicon; and ethernet switches, as well as network operation systems. The company was formerly known as Centec Networks (Suzhou) Co., Ltd and changed its name to Suzhou Centec Communications Co., Ltd. in June 2021. Suzhou Centec Communications Co., Ltd. founded in 2005 and is based in Suzhou, China.
